subject: Sunbird platform: PO eligibility, invoice holds, and vendor registration next steps
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria@sunbird.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@sunbird.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor registration + invoice hold on PO 4312

Hi Jasmine,

We're trying to process Redwood invoices for PO 4312 but our AP system placed them on hold — missing vendor registration and unclear PO linkage. Can you confirm Redwood's legal name, remit bank details and whether you can provide a formatted invoice that includes the Sunbird PO number in the invoice header (not just the line items)?

Also, for our EU entity we need either a VAT registration number or confirmation that reverse-charge applies and a W-9 for the US tax team. I'm attaching the vendor-registration form we require.

Can you get this back to us by EOD Thursday so we can clear the holds for the weekly payment run?

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Gomez
Head of Payments Operations
Sunbird Platforms
Attachment: Sunbird_Vendor-Registration_Form.xlsx

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@sunbird.io>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sunbird.io>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + invoice hold on PO 4312

Hi Maria — thanks for flagging this.

Quick answers up front:
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit: Redwood Inference, Inc. — ACH: ACH-*****1234 (Wells Fargo); for EFT wire, please use Swift WFBIUS6S, account ****5678 (we can provide formal remittance instructions PDF).
- We will re-issue the invoice with the Sunbird PO 4312 in the invoice header (Invoice number: RWI-20271110-009).
- VAT: Redwood does not have an EU VAT number for this contract; we confirm reverse-charge applies for services to Sunbird EU entity. We will also attach a completed W-9 for your US tax team.

I've attached: the completed onboarding packet, an example invoice formatted per your request, and the vendor-registration form you sent back with our entries.

Action items I will own: re-send the formatted invoice and vendor packet to AP, and follow up if anything else is missing. Laura — looping you for collections tracking and to make sure we don't duplicate the invoice submission.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Strategic Accounts — East
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Sunbird_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf; PO-4312_example.pdf; Sunbird_Vendor-Registration_Form_filled.xlsx

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Vendor registration + invoice hold on PO 4312

Forwarding Sunbird's ask — AP put our invoices on hold pending registration. I already sent back the filled packet & example invoice, but we should align on two things before I push final:

1) PO matching field: Sunbird requires the PO number in the invoice header (they said header, not just line items). Our invoice template currently populates PO per-line only. Karthik, can legal/finance sign off on adding a header field that prints the PO? This is low-risk but needs a manifest update.

2) VAT / tax handling: They want confirmation of reverse-charge and a W-9. For EU sales we treat this as B2B reverse-charge. Grace, can you confirm the wording we should include on the invoice to satisfy Sunbird EU (they accept the phrase: "Reverse charge: Article 194/196 - VAT due by the recipient").

If we get both cleared today I will notify AP and ask them to release the hold for this week's payment run.

- Jasmine

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor registration + invoice hold on PO 4312

Jasmine — quick notes from Finance:
- Adding PO to the invoice header is fine, it's a template tweak in our billing manifest. Karthik — please route a quick change request to billing-engine; target is to ship the template change by EOD today.
- For EU reverse-charge wording, Finance prefers: "VAT reverse charge - Article 194(1) of Council Directive 2006/112/EC; VAT accounted for by the recipient." Grace, can you confirm this wording is acceptable to Sunbird?
- We should also include the Sunbird remit address and a contact email (ap-team@sunbird.io) on the remittance instructions to reduce follow-up.

I'll be available to approve the final invoice once Karthik pushes the template; Jasmine, hold off sending the final file until I confirm.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sunbird.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria@sunbird.io>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@sunbird.io>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + invoice hold on PO 4312 — confirmation

Hi Jasmine and team — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We received the updated onboarding packet and the reissued invoice with the PO 4312 in the header (Invoice RWI-20271110-009). AP confirmed the example invoice meets the header requirement and the vendor-registration form is complete. The EU wording you proposed is acceptable.

Next steps on our side:
- We'll release the holds and include RWI-20271110-009 in the Wednesday payment run if no further exceptions surface.
- For tax, Sunbird EU will perform a brief vendor validation; if they need any additional evidence about reverse-charge treatment we may reach back out, but it should be routine.

Thanks — please confirm when you have sent the final remittance PDF to ap-team@sunbird.io and we'll mark this vendor as active.

Best,
Tom Ellis
AP Manager
Sunbird Platforms
